title: SpellCore Focus: Core Loop
summary: Select, pay, cast, read feedback, and wait for cooldown before the next spell.

blocks.title: Select
blocks.body: Sneak-cycle starter spells until the HUD or focus state shows the spell you intend to use.

blocks.title: Cast
blocks.body: Confirm aether cost and cooldown, then cast server-authoritatively so the result is consistent in multiplayer.

blocks.title: Recover
blocks.body: Wait out cooldown, reposition, or switch tools. Spamming a focus is usually a resource problem disguised as impatience.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
